objective: Add revision-independent runtime build and stable lease identity contracts for authenticated presence while preserving every existing revision-bearing save fence and wire schema.
closed_decisions: RuntimeBuildIdentity contains exactly GameBuildId, Sha256Digest, MgbaVersion, BridgeAbiVersion, and ProtocolVersion. It never contains save Revision, shard, region, username, or caller-controlled extension data.

StableRuntimeSession contains exactly SessionId, CharacterId, SessionEpoch, and ClientInstanceId. RuntimeLeaseFence combines StableRuntimeSession plus RuntimeBuildIdentity. It excludes Revision, expiry, heartbeat cadence, tokens, and mutable presence pose.

Additive conversions derive RuntimeBuildIdentity from CompatibilityTarget and StableRuntimeSession from LeaseFence/LeaseContract. Conversions must copy only validated strong types; do not parse arbitrary maps or JSON blobs.

Do not change the serialized shape, constructors, or semantics of LeaseFence, LeaseContract, CompatibilityTarget, resume manifests, snapshots, acquire/heartbeat/reconnect/release requests, or any existing API. Save operations continue to use the revision-bearing LeaseFence.

Runtime identity equality and hashing are revision-independent. Two CompatibilityTargets differing only in Revision yield equal RuntimeBuildIdentity values; any build field difference yields inequality. Two lease fences differing only in Revision yield equal StableRuntimeSession values; session, character, epoch, or client changes yield inequality.

All new public structured JSON types deny unknown fields and reuse existing bounded/validated strong ID and compatibility types. No token, password, ticket, secret, URL, or raw emulator path may enter these types or their Debug output.

This unit defines the trust-bearing types only. The later authenticated server adapter owns persistence/binding of RuntimeBuildIdentity to an active lease and ticket issuance; do not add server, launcher, sidecar, or transport behavior here.

acceptance_criteria.description: RuntimeBuildIdentity and StableRuntimeSession/RuntimeLeaseFence expose only the exact closed fields, validate through existing strong types, and round-trip strict JSON.
CompatibilityTarget and lease/fence additive conversion methods produce revision-independent identities without changing any existing serialized contract or constructor.
Tests prove revision changes preserve runtime identity while every build/session/character/epoch/client change partitions it, and unknown/malformed JSON is rejected.
Cloud and workspace compilation tests, strict cloud clippy, formatting, locked metadata, and diff checks pass with changes confined to owned_files.

forbidden_changes: Do not edit Cargo manifests/lock, protocol/server/sidecar/launcher, C/ROM, Lua/bridge, generators/manifests, docs outside this contract, or orchestration artifacts.

Do not add runtime build fields to existing lease/save wire formats in this unit, remove or ignore Revision from save fencing, accept unvalidated strings for strong IDs, add dependencies, unsafe Rust, allow attributes, or secrets.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact remotes, create/remove worktrees, or revert another worker's edits.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and verification outcomes are recorded.
An existing public wire contract would need a breaking change or the implementation would cross owned_files.
